newsitem.title: USA: Rymac says Navistar to hold stake.
newsitem.headline: Rymac says Navistar to hold stake.

text.p: Rymac Mortgage Investment Corp agreed to acquire a majority interest in Navistar International Corp's Columbus Plastics unit in exchange for a 45 percent stake in Rymac, the companies said in a joint statement.

Under the terms of the $38 million agreement, Rymac will acquire the assets of the Columbus Plastics Operation for a note in the principal amount of $25,504,000 and 4,264,000 newly issued shares of RYMAC common stock, the companies said.

The agreement provides that the shares to be issued to Navistar will be reduced, if necessary, to preserve RYMAC's capability to apply its net operating losses to post-closing income, the companies said.

Such price adjustments could be triggered if other investors buy Rymac common stock that would result in an ownership position of 5 percent or more by any single investor or by investors acting together, the companies said.
Navistar will receive added principal payments on the note if the combined company achieves earnigs above projected levels during 1997 through 1999, Navistar and Rymac said.
The transaction is expected to be completed by year end and is contingent upon approval of RYMAC stockholders at a special stockholders meeting and other conditions, the companies said.
All of the employees at Columbus Plastics will remain with the new company, the companies said.
